name: adrianj98-skills
description: Claude Code plugins and skills by adrianj98

plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.description: A reviewer that assumes your code is wrong, in a context window that never saw you write it. Split-context review modelled on Bun's Zig-to-Rust rewrite.

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: A very short list of what you worked on since your last working day, from the commits in every worktree of the current repo, your GitHub PRs, your Jira issues and any aj-log.md.

plugins.name: deslop
plugins.description: Finds the AI slop in what just changed — restating comments, defensive checks on trusted values, dead abstraction, inflated prose — reports it, and on request cuts it.

plugins.name: showmethedata
plugins.description: Point it at a file, type, table, field or feature and it explains how that data is stored and used — where it lives, its shape across layers and where the shapes drift, who writes it, who reads it, how it moves, and when it dies.

plugins.name: doubt
plugins.description: Questions an analysis or diagnosis the AI gave: splits it into claims, checks the load-bearing ones in a fresh context, names the explanations it skipped, and says what holds, what's wrong and what was never verified.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Light caveman mode: short, plain, filler-free replies for the rest of the session. Code, errors and technical terms stay exact; warnings stay in full sentences.

plugins.name: progress
plugins.description: Where a branch and its pull request stand: what it's about, then its state — review, checks, conflicts, what's unpushed, and the one thing left before it merges.

plugins.name: work-band
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with this branch's PR checks, Jira status and changed files, panes for each, and a button that starts or restarts the dev server.

plugins.name: greenlight
plugins.description: Merges the default branch into the current branch, pushes, and reruns the pull request's required integration check when it was skipped. A skill only, no script.
